about: The declared list of stand-ins (FL0, SSE4-visual-flourish-design.md sections 2, 3 rule 7 and 8A): every place a cheap picture is shown while the clock, the camera or the place moves faster than the device can rebuild the proper one. Data only. Each use names its kind (design 4.2), what moves it, the kernel numbers it reads, its fudge register row (file under docs/fudges/ and the row's opening words), whether the note says so today, and the package that moves it onto the settle schedule (settle.ts). FL4 adds the test that every use here has its register row and every stand-in row in the register is a use here.

uses.proper: the kernel's orbits_at answer, about ten a second

register.row: Orbits run on between the kernel's answers

numbers: mean eastward wind of the highest showing deck by row (weather)
uses.proper: the giant's face as read; the stirred still once PR 739 lands
sharp cells, each at its own place in its life
16 to 32 finer frames averaged, half a second after the view stops

uses.driven_by: frame time, not movement: on a slow device it can stay at rest, as the coarser proper picture the design's rule 4 allows, said

numbers: the kernel's surface tiles at each read depth
uses.proper: the face composed from the finest tiles read

not_stand_ins.why: Drawn where it truly is at each picture, moving or not, so what is seen is the proper picture every time; it is the Too fast state's test, not a stand-in. Its long exposure (CLK3) would be one, and joins this list when built.

coming.why: The stirred still (PR 739) held or carried between rebuilds. It is declared here, with its register row, by FL3, which puts it on the schedule.
